note: Board-specific semantic intent for the toolkit's critical-topology planner. The planner owns the generic machinery (verified escapes, process-checked stitching vias); this file says only WHICH structures this board needs and at WHICH declared values. Every value is the board's own: track/clearance from the MANUAL_CRITICAL and PLANE net classes, via geometry from the Default class, the mask annulus target from the manifest's via_mask design target, hole-to-hole from the board's minimum.

escapes.note: Deterministic pre-routing escape stubs for every pad the general router cannot enter at the declared floors: the microphone signal pads inside the guard ring (VDD, clock, data), the clock-buffer's pads, and the series resistors' pads - the router's own tier table would otherwise thread these with sub-floor slivers, which the pinned fab floors now forbid.

stitches.note: Guard-ring GND copper reaches the internal planes through planner-placed vias just outside the do-not-allow-vias areas, mirroring the pattern the authoritative board's own geometry proves at these exact land patterns.

vdd_last_mile.note: Microphone VDD pockets: when the staged router leaves a MIC_VDD net partial, the planner connects the stranded pad group to the net's other copper with a verified local run.
